transcript:
Considering all the changes that have taken place, I would have expected nothing less.
I can live with the survivors who move like holographic phantoms and spend every waking hour scavenging for whatever will keep them alive.
Indeed, as I write this, I am sitting here, the door open to make the space feel larger.
But it's the dust that suffocates me and challenges my sanity.
source: Andrew Robinson · A Stitch in Time · official audiobook reading
